14machans: Roland Machans signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-C1 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Machans watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Roland Machans washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Roland Machans answered to number 786.
broxxhemi: On Day 9 Isidor Broxxhemi took a post at R-R14 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-R14. Isidor Broxxhemi has learned to walk bent double.

Isidor Broxxhemi found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. The clerk counted the names twice. Isidor Broxxhemi is number 925 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
dank.ricefarmer: Severin Ricefarmer told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
A patient at the aid post asked Severin Ricefarmer for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.

The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Severin Ricefarmer asks about each detail while changing the dressing. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close. The transfer made Severin Ricefarmer a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Severin Ricefarmer landed next to Walter Caleb in the Hegemony trench. Only Severin Ricefarmer climbed back out. (@ya_man_caleb) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Severin Ricefarmer watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close.

Severin Ricefarmer spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home found Severin Ricefarmer before the night shift. Severin Ricefarmer folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Severin Ricefarmer answered to number 494.
darth._.vicious: Otto "Parson" Vicious reported to S-S5 with a frozen apple sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Otto "Parson" Vicious checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
Otto "Parson" Vicious tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Millbank. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
A parcel came for Otto "Parson" Vicious that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Brass cases piled up around Otto "Parson" Vicious's boots at S-S5. Out of all those rounds, one found Leopold Rossfm, badly wounded. A round came through the loophole Otto "Parson" Vicious was watching at S-S5 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Dorian Maxhuntertat of the Concord (@maxhuntertattoos). Otto "Parson" Vicious was killed outright at S-S5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Dorian Maxhuntertat of the Concord (@maxhuntertattoos).
Quentin Vicious joined S-S5 under the shadow of Otto "Parson" Vicious's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Quentin Vicious offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Quentin Vicious answered to number 454.
decybecy66: The old hands of R-R15 have been here since Day 1. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Silas Tadzyman and Bastian "Mud" Decybecy made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bastian "Mud" Decybecy answered to number 958.
highspeed_nodrag1833: Bastian Nodrag introduced himself as a tailor from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A bullet went through Bastian Nodrag's sleeve at R-F3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).

Bastian Nodrag's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bastian Nodrag wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Bastian Nodrag lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Bastian Nodrag tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Bastian Nodrag pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Bastian Nodrag put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.

Bastian Nodrag crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Ulrich Seths reached for a rifle. Bastian Nodrag was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@seths110) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Bastian Nodrag watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Bastian Nodrag drew a map of Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat's hometown from Tin's stories. Tin says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Bastian Nodrag got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 303. The men who came later will ask about it.
john.michael2877: Isidor "Saint" Michael joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Isidor "Saint" Michael fell asleep on watch. Leopold Evans took over without waking Saint, and told the sergeant nothing.
lebronmygoat25: At the depot, Quentin Lebronmygoat had practised answering to his name. At R-S10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A shell hit the latrine at R-S10. Nobody was hurt. Quentin Lebronmygoat says it was the best day of the war. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Quentin Lebronmygoat did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Quentin Lebronmygoat passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
Quentin Lebronmygoat noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
A note came over the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Quentin Lebronmygoat.' Edmund Callmequeeno sang louder.
The men have learned that Quentin Lebronmygoat is always the first one awake. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.

Quentin Lebronmygoat fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Jakub Hans, now grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S10 changed before the cheering ended. Quentin Lebronmygoat shouldered another load.

A grenade fragment found Quentin Lebronmygoat's shoulder. He calls it a souvenir and refuses to be sent back. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Lebronmygoat is number 368. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
nouniquetag: Bastian Nouniquetag took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
A parcel from home held a comb. Bastian Nouniquetag has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
pastaeaterxavi: On the way to R-C1, Emil Pastaeaterxa tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C1 changed before the cheering ended. Emil Pastaeaterxa shouldered another load.

A bullet struck Emil Pastaeaterxa below the ribs at R-C1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Ulrich Porsche of the Concord (@porsche930tt). Emil Pastaeaterxa was hit at R-C1 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Ulrich Porsche of the Concord (@porsche930tt).

Bram Pastaeaterxa arrived carrying the family name of Emil Pastaeaterxa. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bram Pastaeaterxa answered to number 822.
preston_dv: Nobody saw Benedikt Preston arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in T-F6, and a quiet chaplain under it.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F6 with the rations. Benedikt Preston ate while listening to the revised orders.

Benedikt Preston was hit in the forearm at T-F6. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony (@colinhydee).
pugxelot: By the time Oskar Pugxelot reached Q-F1, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
A dog crosses no man's land at Blackwater Canal every night, fed by Oskar Pugxelot on one side and Leopold "Crow" Napoleon on the other. The Hegemony call it Patrol. The Concord call it Spy.
ryukov46: Arno "Tin" Ryukov arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Arno "Tin" Ryukov let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Arno "Tin" Ryukov was waiting. Jonas "Parson" Underthrone was grazed.
sovietkitten1: Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten came up with a draft of replacements on Day 7. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a lock of hair in a matchbox. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten left the photograph on a stake in the wire at Calvary Farm, wrapped in oilcloth. In the morning it was gone. In its place: a single cigarette. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich "Mole" Sovietkitten is number 488. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
taylerbradley__: Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle reached T-F3 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Jonas "Bones" Taylerbradle lent Henrik "Bones" Spencercenso a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
zach_gossett: Albin "Whistle" Gossett came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Albin "Whistle" Gossett folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Albin "Whistle" Gossett left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
